Desk epoch-equivalence check replays the authenticated ledger snapshot once to read one closed derivation night's retained values and compare them with the acceptance envelope in force; it never mints, appends a receipt, publishes a binding, issues or continues an acceptance, or finalizes an analysis manifest, and its only output is a JSON record written outside configs/calibration.

Retained-corpus CLI main -> extract_cells -> AuthenticatedConsumptionSession -> snapshot and bracket candidate discovery; derives extraction reports without mint, ledger append, binding publication, or analysis-manifest finalization.

G2-a harvest replays the full physical ledger against the committed seed pin only after a verified byte archive, authenticating the frozen baseline and capture custody; an open session is admitted only as a governed open extension. Abort and pin advancement use recover_calibration_ledger.py's governed procedures, not this replay snapshot.

For a closed bracket session, G2-a harvest replays the ledger against a scratch pin taken from terminal_head_pin_for_session (never a mid-session receipt) to authenticate the terminal head for its archived diagnostic verdict; the scratch pin is never committed and no receipt is appended.

After independent seed and terminal-head custody authentication, G2-a harvest replays the same physical ledger and selected pin against the plan-bound default acceptance cutoff for its diagnostic bracket decision. Snapshot refusal reasons remain RECOVER causes; this view never appends a receipt or publishes a binding.

G2-a harvest re-evaluates retained member and pre/post bracket custody against live acceptance for its archived diagnostic verdict; no claim mint, binding publication or analysis-manifest finalization. Governed terminal-pin writes reauthenticate independently through the recovery CLI.

Harvest replays the committed terminal ledger with verify_custody=False, authenticates captures and committed battery verdicts separately, and archives copies without ledger append, acceptance issuance, binding publication or analysis-manifest finalization.

prepare-candidate replays the authenticated ledger snapshot to select registration members and derive a NOT-ISSUED candidate acceptance written only to --out outside configs/calibration; it never mints, appends a receipt, publishes a binding, or finalizes an analysis manifest, and the emitted file is refused by the production loader (candidate_not_issued).

Read-only desk epoch watch and blind registration dry run replay the existing ledger snapshot once to compare identity fields, print a table and, with --session-ids, report session kinds/states/slot counts; never mints, appends a receipt, publishes a binding, or finalizes an analysis manifest.

battery-verdict replays the committed ledger snapshot at harvest to read one terminal session's rows and write its battery-float verdict file exclusively under configs/calibration/battery_float_verdicts/; it never mints, appends a receipt, publishes a binding, or finalizes an analysis manifest.

The cadence report replays the committed ledger snapshot to find one terminal session and its committed battery-float verdict, then prints native-frame statistics to stdout; it never mints, appends a receipt, publishes a binding, or finalizes an analysis manifest.
